image_description: A close-up, angled view of a glass display case in a bakery filled with various baked goods. The foreground features round loaves of bread and pastries on metal trays. Behind the glass, shelves hold more breads, including baguettes and rustic loaves. A green box sits on an upper shelf. The background shows a brick wall and a partial view of a red sign or poster. The lighting is warm and artificial, reflecting off the glass surfaces.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The texture of the closest round loaf appears slightly overly smooth and plastic-like compared to the rougher crusts further back, lacking fine crumb detail.
The vertical black mullion on the left bends slightly unnaturally near the bottom, and reflections on the glass show minor inconsistencies in continuity.
The items on the very top shelf in the background (left side) appear to merge into each other and the wall, lacking distinct boundaries or structural logic.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the items are correctly classified as specific types of bread/pastries and not generic blobs.
To check for edge bleeding between the glass reflections, the metal frame, and the background wall.
To assess the realism of textures (crust vs. plastic) and lighting consistency.
To ensure the shelves recede logically in 3D space and don't warp or float.

focus_areas: Texture realism of bread crusts (foreground vs background)
Geometric integrity of glass reflections and frame lines
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' sheen on the foreground bread. AI often fails to render the porous, dry texture of fresh bread crust, resulting in a waxy appearance. Also, scrutinize the intersection of the glass frame and the background; look for subtle warping or blending that violates rigid body physics.
